sectionSubtitle: Three structured ways to partner — designed for operational clarity, predictable turnaround, and zero micromanagement.

models.title: Operational Right-Hand
models.tagline: Ongoing async partnership for founders needing continuous operational bandwidth.
models.bestFor: Solo founders, creators, or boutique agencies needing 10–20 hours/week of dedicated operational support.
deliverables: Proactive problem solving & weekly status recaps
models.cadence: Daily async logs via Slack/Notion + Weekly Loom check-in

models.title: Systems & Automation Sprint
models.tagline: End-to-end design and build for a specific operational bottleneck.
models.bestFor: Teams struggling with messy spreadsheets, manual POS/inventory, or disconnected tools who want a turnkey system.
deliverables: Full bespoke Google Sheets system architecture

models.title: Executive Research Dossier
models.tagline: Decision-ready market intelligence, competitor benchmarking, or lead sourcing.
models.bestFor: Founders planning a new product launch, market entry, or preparing an investment memo.
deliverables: Curated, verified lead database (if sourcing leads)

customNote: Need a trial engagement or hybrid arrangement? Every partnership starts with a short scoping conversation to align on exact outcomes.
